title: mzCache: On-Device LLM Memory Management under Multitasking (MobiCom 2026 Artifact)
description:
Artifact for the MobiCom 2026 paper "mzCache: On-Device LLM Memory Management under Multitasking".

This artifact contains the full implementation of mzCache (a restoration-oriented memory management system for on-device LLM inference, implemented as a fork of llama.cpp), together with the two baselines used in the paper (Partial Offload and OS Paging), the Android application used for the real-world evaluation, and scripts that reproduce the paper's key results on commodity smartphones. EVALUATION.md at the repository root is the step-by-step guide.
